```{r}
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(starwars, aes(x=height, y=eye_color, color=mass)) +
  geom_line(aes(group=1), linewidth=3, na.rm=TRUE) +
  geom_point(size=9, shape=8, na.rm=TRUE) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low="#FFFF00",
    high="#FFAA00",
    na.value="#FFFF55",
    name="GOOD LUCK"
  ) +
  labs(
    title="STAR WARS DATA!!!!!!!! WHY IS ANY OF THIS CONNECTED",
    x="Height (cm)",
    y="Eye color"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.background=element_rect(fill="#FFFF00", color="#FFAA00"),
    panel.background=element_rect(fill="#FFD800"),
    panel.grid.major=element_line(color="#FFAA00", linewidth=2),
    panel.grid.minor=element_line(color="#FFFF00", linewidth=1),
    text=element_text(color="#FFBB00"),
    plot.title=element_text(size=28, angle=7),
    axis.text.x=element_text(color="#FFCC00", angle=83, size=5),
    axis.text.y=element_text(color="#FFCC00", angle=47, size=6),
    axis.title=element_text(color="#FFBB00", size=30),
    legend.background=element_rect(fill="#FFFF00"),
    legend.key=element_rect(fill="#FFD800"),
    legend.text=element_text(color="#FFCC00", size=5),
    legend.position="bottom"
  )

# confidence: 100/100
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

darkTriadDat <- read_csv("darkTriad_Data-1.csv")

# Assigned the plot to an object (darkTriadDat instead of darkTriadPat)
worstGraph <- ggplot(darkTriadDat, aes(x = country, y = Narcissism)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "gray55") +
  geom_point(color = "gray45") +
  theme_dark() + 
  labs(
    title = "Informative Line Graph",
    x = "country",
    y = "Narcissism"
  )

# Export as PNG for Mac compatibility
ggsave(
  filename = "iiworstNarcissismGraph.png",
  plot = worstGraph,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

darkTriadDat <- read_csv("darkTriad_Data-1.csv")

scoreType <- factor(
  c("Narcissism", "Machiavellianism", "Psychopathy"),
  levels=c("Narcissism", "Machiavellianism", "Psychopathy")
)

averageScore <- c(
  mean(darkTriadDat$Narcissism, na.rm=TRUE),
  mean(darkTriadDat$Machiavellianism, na.rm=TRUE),
  mean(darkTriadDat$Psychopathy, na.rm=TRUE)
)

averageDat <- cbind.data.frame(scoreType, averageScore)

ggplot(averageDat, aes(x=scoreType, y=averageScore, fill=scoreType)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue", "red", "forestgreen")) +
scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 5), breaks=seq(0, 5, by=0.2)) +
  labs(x="Score Type", y="Average Score") +
  theme(legend.position="none")
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

darkTriadDat <- read_csv("darkTriad_Data-1.csv")

# Create a clean scatter plot with a linear trendline
bestNarcissismGraph <- ggplot(darkTriadDat, aes(x = Machiavellianism, y = Narcissism)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.15, color = "blue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Machiavellianism vs Narcissism Correlation",
    x = "Machiavellianism Score",
    y = "Narcissism Score"
  )

# Export high-resolution PNG for Canvas
ggsave(
  filename = "bestNarcissismGraph.png",
  plot = bestNarcissismGraph,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
